The controls for OpenFront use a combination of keyboard and mouse actions. They can be rebound by going into Settings → Keybinds.

PC

Default Controls
Keyboard Mouse Action
W Left Click & Drag Down Pans the camera North.
A Left Click & Drag Right Pans the camera West.
S Left Click & Drag Up Pans the camera South.
D Left Click & Drag Left Pans the camera East.
C Focuses the camera on the player.
Space (hold) Alternate view that reveals terrain and highlights key points.
U Changes the arc that the Atom / Hydrogen Bomb takes to hit the target.
Left Click Attacks territory.
Right Click Opens the build menu; if a Warship or boat is selected, right-click cancels that selection instead (Update 33.0)
Alt + Left Click Open emoji menu
T Shift + Scroll Down Decrease Attack Ratio
Y Shift + Scroll Up Increase Attack Ratio
Q / - Scroll Down Zooms Out
E / + Scroll Up Zooms in
F Sends a boat attack to tile under cursor
G Sends a ground attack to tile under cursor
1 Builds a City on tile under cursor
2 Builds a Factory on tile under cursor
3 Builds a Port on tile under cursor
4 Builds a Defense Post on tile under cursor
5 Builds a Missile Silo on tile under cursor
6 Builds a SAM Launcher on tile under cursor
7 Send a Warship to tile under cursor
8 Sends an Atom Bomb to tile under cursor
9 Sends a Hydrogen Bomb to tile under cursor
0 Sends a MIRV to tile under cursor
Alt + R Reset Graphics. Used to quickly fix certain graphical bugs
